moments.author: Tim Cook
moments.quote: Our thoughts are with all those affected by the tragic flash floods and mudslides in Nepal and Tibet. Apple is making a donation to support relief and rebuilding efforts on the ground.
moments.why: Tim Cook’s humanitarian tweet ahead of his CEO exit is sparking heavy engagement among audiences aged 25–45.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Grok Bot can now buy things on the internet. To get started, connect @link, send your Bot shopping, and it can complete purchases on your behalf.
moments.why: Elon Musk’s post about Grok Bot’s shopping capability is trending among tech‑savvy men keen on AI utility.

moments.author: MensHumor
moments.quote: Healthcare has officially reached the “Would you like to add entertainment to your suffering?” stage.
moments.why: This brutal healthcare joke is resonating across male audiences, generating widespread shares and reaction.
